profile_production.shared_clip_mask: one Gate-3 reservoir sigma-clip decision per (native pixel, channel) feeds all four profiles; quality values never enter clipping
profile_production.quality_fold: per-candidate means over the frame's droplets: sum(area_j * clamp(q_j,0,inf)) / b_src over the same finite-source population; missing streams fold to 1.0; nonpositive/NaN quality contributes 0 (veto); artifact applicability tracked by finite-sample area (qaf plane)
profile_production.outputs: value = sum(w*x)/sum(w), weight_sum, n_eff = sum(w)^2/sum(w^2), support iff weight_sum > 0; fallback paths emit the uniform stream value and zero alpha factors

device_layout.quality_uploads_per_frame: four f32 source planes qc/q0/q1/qa (absent = null)
device_layout.quality_frame_planes: five f64 accumulators Qc/Q0/Q1/Qa/Qaf at internal resolution
device_layout.reservoir_side_array: float4 {qc,q0,q1,qa} per kept slot, qa<0 sentinel = no artifact data; moved together with records during the clip-path insertion sort
device_layout.frame_meta: V2FrameMetaDev 16 B per frame slot {g_eff, residual_factor, is_direct, pad}, uploaded per accumulate_frame call, bounds-checked by meta_capacity at finalize
device_layout.profile_emission: k_finalize_v2 reduces all four profiles plus a_separation/a_artifact/a_registration into an 80 B ForwardDrizzleV2ProfileResult per (pixel, channel)

alpha_and_confidence.a_separation: clamp01(Gate-4 per-pixel confidence); a fully degraded sigma population (all accepted candidates with invalid sigma2) is diagnosed as no separation evidence and collapses a_separation to 0
alpha_and_confidence.a_artifact: weighted p10 of qa over clip-accepted contributions through the plan-14.4 smoothstep; qa absent -> artifact alpha 0, not applicable
alpha_and_confidence.a_registration: is_direct/residual_factor contributions over the accepted set
alpha_and_confidence.channel_min: forward_drizzle_v2_profile_alpha_plane aggregates OSC channel alphas by per-pixel minimum
alpha_and_confidence.diagnostic: ForwardDrizzleV2AlphaDiagnostic flags globally near-zero alpha explicitly; never a silent success

ring_contract.semantics: in-order band finalization, duplicate/out-of-range finalize rejected, immutable fused core reported once every band inside the vertical halo is committed
ring_contract.resident_bound: floor(2*halo/band_rows)+2 finalized bands worst case, enforced and asserted
ring_contract.counters: source_reused_bytes/quality_reused_bytes count overlap rows served from the retained predecessor tail

reuse_aware_read_amplification.model: application reads each needed source row once plus one halo pad per image edge; toy geometries are behavioral tests, the RA <= 1.1 gate applies to the selected production tile plan
reuse_aware_read_amplification.production_check: 7868x4540 canvas at the gate-5 band plan meets RA <= 1.1 with halo 64

fusion.parity: fuse_multiband_streamed on v2 profile planes is bit-identical to fuse_multiband on supported pixels (NaN-aware comparison); the documented B3 flood-fill stripe-boundary pinch remains the only caveat
fusion.support: fused support is a subset of uniform/raw support; multiband never widens support
fusion.grid: v2 native output grid; at internal_scale=2 the same level count covers half the physical frequency reach of the legacy internal-res fusion, arbitrated by matched-star validation

verified: zero effective multiband stars block multiband promotion
multiband == raw fails the strict improvement gate and selects raw
raw safety regression (background RMS) falls back to uniform
uniform and raw remain immutable controls at matched star positions

measured.note: the 14600 estimate undercounted the per-slot side array (16 B x 128 slots = 2048 B/channel, not 1024 B/px); the amended plan bound is the binding figure and the kernel fits it

implementation_findings.reservoir_sort_side_array: records are insertion-sorted by (x, frame_order) at finalize; the first revision read resq by the sorted index while it stayed in slot order, misassigning quality means (fine weight 0.0148 vs 0.1806). Fixed by moving a local float4 copy alongside the records.
implementation_findings.fixed_slot_accounting: device_bytes_per_native_pixel initially counted the four quality upload planes and the meta table as per-pixel state; they are fixed pipeline slots like src/sigma2 and are now excluded. Scalar side-array accounting aligned to the allocated 3 u64.
implementation_findings.finite_population: device quality accumulation masks by source finiteness, exactly matching the b_src contributor population; the CPU oracle replicates this.
implementation_findings.nan_aware_parity: streamed-vs-whole-frame parity compares values with exact-or-both-NaN semantics.

coverage: device profile parity vs CPU oracle: scale 1/2, MONO/OSC, identity-Q, NaN/nonpositive veto, missing streams, g_eff!=1, shared clip mask, overflow fallback
degraded sigma2 device case: a_separation collapses to 0 on all supported pixels
ring: immutability point, resident bound, first/last edges, duplicate/out-of-range rejection
reuse RA: halo 0/14/62 counters and toy behavior, production-scale RA <= 1.1
fusion: streamed vs whole-frame parity, support subset, levels 1..4, v2 adapter into ForwardDrizzleUniformResult
confidence calibration clean/degraded, channel-min alpha, near-zero diagnostic
matched-star validation: zero-star block, equality gate, raw safety fallback
memory amendment: profiled plan roles, bounded footprint on production geometry

deferred: Gate 10: runner wiring, device-fusion re-decision if measured fusion time violates budget, band-store integration of the ring with the gate-7 checkpoint
